subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81c369cdc5da36dd3f6f8dd49d38699bb6ed5cc2da72e76411cf64689c9dfdf8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**(Top number + left number) - (Bottom number + right number) = Middle number**

Figure 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b776f36ce3292a59c8660f428d27a59784ecb8f4bfa5197b436a51f3f038a6f.png] 

= (10 + 12) - (5 + 7)

= 22 - 12

= 10

Figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc5f6c1d605e4f603f3a583c91ef7e4f8c4637fcf072af385a0cec906c4992e.png] 

= (16 + 11) - (4 + 8)

= 27 - 12

= 15

**Figure 3:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/982816194a6830b5a1dada119b0eb15df815c1960602936f69384c4bda2c86b8.png] **

**= (15 + 9) - (5 + 6)**

**= 24 - 11**

**= 13**

Hence, the correct answer is **"13".**
